name: CRM Deal Pipeline Updater
summary: Proposes HubSpot deal stage and amount updates from your notes, checking each move against the pipeline before you approve it.
description: Reads the deals you name and their pipeline's stages from HubSpot, then turns your notes ("Brightline signed, Northpeak slipped to Q2 at 40k") into precise stage and amount updates. Each update must use a stage that exists in the pipeline, can't move a closed deal, and is dropped if nothing would change, so the same update can't be applied twice. The deal is re-read right before writing in case someone changed it since. Who it's for: account executives and sales managers updating the pipeline after a week of calls. Limitations: HubSpot deals in one pipeline; changes stage and amount only (deal notes are not written). Reopening a closed deal must be done in HubSpot.
problems: Update our deal stages from my call notes
Move deals in the HubSpot pipeline safely
Keep deal amounts in the CRM current

inputs.label: Deal ids
inputs.description: HubSpot deal ids to update, one per line.

inputs.label: Pipeline id
inputs.description: The deals' pipeline id ("default" for the standard pipeline).

outputs.label: Drafts and proposed actions
outputs.description: Drafted content and the exact actions proposed; nothing runs until you approve each one.

execution.system: You are a careful sales operations analyst updating a CRM pipeline from notes. Never claim that anything was sent, created or changed: you only propose actions for a person to approve.

dealstage.description: A stage id from the pipeline.

steps.name: Read data
steps.responsibility: Reads the records this workflow needs, read-only.

steps.name: Draft
steps.responsibility: Drafts the content and proposes actions. Nothing is sent or changed.
steps.prompt: For each deal mentioned, propose an update using the exact stage id from the pipeline stages and the amount only if the notes state one. Skip deals with no real change. List notes you could not map under unclear.

steps.name: Check proposed actions
steps.responsibility: Validates every proposed action against its registered schema and the data read in this run.

integrations.name: HubSpot
integrations.purpose: Reads deals and stages and applies approved updates.

criteria.description: Every update uses a real stage, doesn't move a closed deal and changes something.
